## 第一次打开 / First launch

GeoCode 没有付费的代码签名证书,第一次打开时系统会拦一下。
GeoCode is not signed with a paid certificate, so the system stops it the first time it opens.

- macOS:把 GeoCode 拖进「应用程序」后打开,出现提示时点「完成」;到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」,在下方点「仍要打开」。
  macOS: drag GeoCode into Applications and open it; when warned, click Done, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
- Windows:出现「Windows 已保护你的电脑」时,点「更多信息」,再点「仍要运行」。
  Windows: when "Windows protected your PC" appears, click More info, then Run anyway.

第一次启动要准备内置的 Python 环境,需要一到两分钟。
The first start prepares the bundled Python environment, which takes a minute or two.
